payload.text: The Crown notes E-001 records Mira's account of a blue-token handover, while E-002 records Tavi's account that no handover was seen. Both are attributed, disputed accounts permitted only to assess the fictional receipt condition. The Crown acknowledges its burden to prove receipt beyond a reasonable doubt rests on these two attributed statements, with no further corroboration in the supplied record. The jury must weigh the conflicting accounts and decide whether the fictional condition has been established.

The Defence agrees with the Crown's accurate concession: E-001 and E-002 are attributed accounts, not independent proof. E-001 records Mira's account of a handover. E-002 records Tavi's account that Fictional Morgan left with the blue token still in hand and no handover was seen. These conflicting, attributed statements cannot establish the fictional blue-token receipt condition beyond a reasonable doubt.
